With this change:

- If the first element in `el.content` is a `Para` (the usual case), we keep the old behavior and inject the bold theorem‐title inline into that paragraph.
- If the first element is a list, we instead insert a brand-new paragraph containing the theorem title right before the list, so it no longer becomes the first bullet/numbered item.
